transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you. Um... well, I guess I'm here because... I just feel like I'm always moving from one thing to the next. Like I can't really just... idle. And, uh, there's a new setup at work recently, which... well, it's just made that a lot harder to hide.
Have you felt this way your entire life, or is this something that has only started happening more recently?

It's... it's not new. It was happening long before this job change. I mean, looking back, even in grade school my teachers used to write things... they'd say I was bright, but, uh, careless. That I talked out of turn. They always had to remind me to just stay with my work. So... yeah. Always been this way, I suppose.

latest_inference.note: The patient's report of lifelong symptoms including impulsivity (talking out of turn), inattention (carelessness), and hyperactivity (always moving) strongly points toward ADHD. The symptoms are pervasive across settings (school and work) and developmental stages, making F90.0 the primary candidate and effectively ruling out the mood/anxiety disorders previously considered.
